verdict.rationale: Headless automation is a fair axis for a compute GPU. The ROCm docs show the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) supported on Linux for PyTorch, JAX and TensorFlow, with workloads run in reproducible Docker containers and vLLM/SGLang serving from prebuilt images, which implies non-interactive, scriptable use. Nothing explicitly documents headless operation or CI integration, and consumer-card features such as AMD Software and HYPR-RX are GUI-oriented. Missing for 10: explicit headless/no-display operation docs, CI runner integration guidance (e.g. GPU passthrough in CI pipelines), and independent hands-on corroboration.
